subject: You can't leave?
author: ZombieTron
body:
erm... I'm not sure what you mean. You can log out of the site, the Log out button is (or should be) at the bottom of Your Menu on the left hand side, just above the BurnoutAholics Menu. Or do you mean you can't delete your profile? cos I'm pretty sure you can, I can delete profiles, so if you wanted to leave you could ask us to do that I guess.

Although we would prefer it if you stayed! 😃

--- The Original and the Best ---
